hook: SCP-5798 lives in the pipes of a YMCA building and talks to people through a shower drain. Most of the file is a single conversation that starts out as a sympathetic chat about burnout. Be warned that its final stretch is extremely graphic body horror.
whyItMatters:
The entry works by mixing two registers that rarely share a page: an overworked junior researcher venting about debt, loneliness and pointless busywork, and a drain monster that sounds like a laid-back friend from an online forum. The comedy of the conversation is what makes the ending land so hard.

It also turns the Foundation's own working conditions into material, letting a researcher say out loud what the archive usually leaves unspoken.
thingsToNotice:
Watch how the creature steers the talk: it offers to listen, urges him to let everything out, describes a life of sleep, movies and games down below, then mentions it gets lonely and suggests he come down. Haddow, who wanted to write romance novels, throws away his notes, curses the Foundation and jumps into the shower.

What follows is described in exhaustive physical detail: his feet are forced through the grate, then his ankles, lower legs, pelvis, torso and finally his head, while he screams, vomits, passes out and comes to again. The last paragraph is the coldest touch, since the entity later speaks with Haddow's voice yet claims not to remember him at all.
